routing_policy: Fold marketplace target development into the five existing active Worldshepherd task lanes; do not create a sixth ChatGPT automation for this scan.
contact_policy: Public evidence may establish a credible need/fit hypothesis but cannot establish target-specific remediation probability. Except for previously existing relationship records, newly discovered targets remain DO_NOT_CONTACT until a target-specific fail-closed evidence gate is created and satisfies the user's 98.7 threshold with external evidence. Existing stricter holds remain controlling.
task_routes: USPTO DOE WEF BDS + Boeing/Spirit Scan

targets.observed_signal: AeroVironment completed the BlueHalo acquisition in 2025; 2026 filings retained material weaknesses involving BlueHalo IT general controls, user/privileged access and segregation of duties, and the company also reported a separate goodwill-control restatement weakness.
targets.notes: Strongest newly identified account because the need signal directly overlaps Worldshepherd access/change/provenance controls and AeroVironment maintains a public potential-supplier portal. Public supplier access does not establish interest or approval.

targets.observed_signal: Air Industries is pursuing a strategic combination with Tenax Aerospace while reporting an unremediated IT-control material weakness involving segregation of duties, data validation, user access and program change management. Air Industries manufactures flight-critical aerospace/defense components.
targets.notes: Very high fit: aerospace/defense manufacturing plus live merger plus IT/data/change-control weakness. Business-development route is public but must not be used before target-specific readiness gate closure.

targets.observed_signal: Airbus completed acquisition of multiple former Spirit industrial assets supporting A220, A320 and A350 programs and is integrating more than 4,000 employees/sites. In September 2026 Airbus temporarily slowed A330 deliveries after a stray tool was discovered in a tail structure, reinforcing a bounded FOD/tool-control quality signal.
targets.notes: Literal sister integration to Boeing/Spirit. The A330 tool event must not be generalized into a systemic Airbus failure claim.

targets.observed_signal: AMSC reported a material weakness around initial purchase accounting and continuing fair-value review associated with the Comtrafo acquisition and is implementing more precise acquisition-review controls.
targets.notes: Worldshepherd scope must remain operational evidence/control support only; no accounting, valuation, audit or fair-value opinions.

targets.observed_signal: Stratasys agreed in May 2026 to acquire Markforged's FFF business for $42.5 million. Seller Nano Dimension previously reported acquisition-accounting control weakness, integration difficulty and a full $40.4 million impairment of Markforged FFF goodwill, making the transition a strong pre-integration evidence-governance case without implying Stratasys has inherited those deficiencies.
targets.notes: Exceptional fit with WS-AlTi/additive evidence architecture, but acquisition has not yet closed and seller weaknesses are not Stratasys weaknesses.

targets.observed_signal: IonQ completed the SkyWater acquisition on July 31, 2026. Before closing, SkyWater disclosed material weaknesses involving revenue-accounting IT controls and Fab 25 account-reconciliation/business-process controls following its Fab 25 acquisition and ERP migration.
targets.notes: An existing IonQ/Vector Atomic outreach-control incident already imposes an inbound-only hold. Do not create a second IonQ contact stream. This target is intelligence/solution-development only until that hold is explicitly resolved.

targets.observed_signal: Siemens Energy states its One Supplier Portal is intended to replace fragmented supplier systems with a single platform spanning procurement, logistics, quality and compliance while the company continues supplier/process modernization across Siemens Gamesa and other business areas.
targets.notes: Strong platform-fragmentation fit. Do not imply Worldshepherd should replace OSP; position only as bounded governance/evidence interoperability around existing systems.

targets.observed_signal: Bombardier agreed in September 2026 to acquire MHI Canada Aerospace assets in Mississauga, adding approximately 750 employees and aerostructure manufacturing capabilities supporting Global aircraft wings.
targets.notes: Pre-integration opportunity signal, not distress. No claim that quality problems exist.

targets.observed_signal: Moog continues to report a material weakness involving completeness/accuracy of key inputs for distinct long-term aftermarket service contracts in Commercial Aircraft; remediation includes access-rights, data-control and change-management improvements. Moog also operates detailed supplier nonconformance/change/corrective-action portals.
targets.notes: Direct software-governance fit, but financial reporting/accounting conclusions remain out of scope.

targets.observed_signal: L3Harris created Missile Solutions in early 2026 by combining missile capabilities including legacy Aerojet Rocketdyne and closed a $1 billion government investment to expand/modernize facilities and increase production capacity.
targets.notes: Scaling/integration signal, not public evidence of control failure. Defense/security/export constraints are high.

targets.observed_signal: Pratt & Whitney GTF availability/maintenance disruption is improving but remains material for larger A320neo fleets; RTX publicly maintains APQP/PPAP, flight-safety-part, supplier-quality and process-control requirements.
targets.notes: Do not imply Worldshepherd can remediate GTF engineering defects; initial wedge is supplier/MRO evidence governance only.

targets.observed_signal: Eastern acquired Sungear and Crown Precision in June 2026 to establish a fourth operating platform focused on aerospace/defense precision manufacturing.
targets.notes: Pre-integration watch; no public distress/control-failure claim.

targets.observed_signal: Super Micro's 2026 Form 10-K reports an unremediated ITGC material weakness around access monitoring and notes significant dependence on suppliers/contract manufacturers meeting quality and delivery requirements.
targets.notes: Adjacent rather than Boeing-like acquisition case; retained because governance/supplier-data pain is explicit.

targets.observed_signal: Solstice announced a $14.5 billion agreement to acquire Element Solutions, creating a large specialty-materials/electronics-chemicals integration expected to close in the first half of 2027.
targets.notes: No distress signal yet; keep as predictive integration watch rather than active remediation target.

targets.observed_signal: Diodes announced a $250 million acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor intended to combine ATE IC technology with Diodes manufacturing scale and global commercial reach.
targets.notes: No public control/quality distress signal; predictive integration target only.

claims_boundary: The registry is a public-source market intelligence and solution-development artifact. Scores rank attention only. They are not probabilities of remediation success, contracting, adoption, partnership, savings, compliance or award. A public acquisition, material weakness, quality incident, supplier portal, transformation program or hiring signal does not establish root cause, customer interest, Worldshepherd fitness for production, or permission to contact.
